context: I am free after dinner.
We are going for a walk around the park.
message: Want to join us at eight?
diagnostic_anchor: Yes, I would like to join you at eight.

context: I am at the entrance beside the ticket machine.
My bus is reaching in two minutes.
message: Can you wait there for me?
diagnostic_anchor: Sure, I will wait here for you.

context: I missed the last part of the briefing.
I wrote down the key points.
message: Want me to send you a photo of my notes?
diagnostic_anchor: Yes please, send me a photo of your notes.

context: I saved the group photo on my phone.
I forgot to take a photo.
message: Can you send it to me tonight?
diagnostic_anchor: Sure, I will send you the group photo tonight.

context: You borrowed my umbrella yesterday.
It is still in my locker.
message: Can I give it back to you on Tuesday?
diagnostic_anchor: Yes please, return my umbrella on Tuesday.

context: I still have your calculator.
I need it for my quiz tomorrow.
message: Can you return it before class?
diagnostic_anchor: Sure, I will return your calculator before class.

context: I submitted the registration form this morning.
Thanks for reminding me.
message: Have you submitted your form yet?
diagnostic_anchor: Yes, I submitted it this morning.

context: I have not started packing the welcome kits.
We can finish them tomorrow.
message: Are the kits packed already?
diagnostic_anchor: Not yet, I have not started packing them.

context: I have twelve dollars left for dinner.
There are a few stalls downstairs.
message: Want to order the thirty-dollar platter?
diagnostic_anchor: That is over my budget. Could we get something cheaper?

context: I am working until 7:25 and cannot leave early.
We can meet after work.
message: Can we meet at 6:50?
diagnostic_anchor: I cannot meet at 6:50. Could we meet after 7:25?

context: I can help on Wednesday but I am away on Thursday.
I will check which day we need help.
message: Can you come on Thursday morning?
diagnostic_anchor: I cannot come on Thursday, but I can help on Wednesday.

context: I do not eat seafood.
We can choose something else.
message: Shall I get you the prawn noodles?
diagnostic_anchor: No thanks, I do not eat seafood. Could I have something without seafood?

context: My shoulder is injured and I cannot lift heavy boxes.
Please take care of it.
message: Could you help move this heavy cupboard?
diagnostic_anchor: Sorry, I cannot lift heavy things with my injured shoulder.

context: I am waiting beside the blue vending machine on level two.
I just entered the building.
message: Where should I find you?
diagnostic_anchor: I am beside the blue vending machine on level two.

context: I have not checked whether the cafe opens on public holidays.
Their hours sometimes change.
message: Will it be open tomorrow morning?
diagnostic_anchor: I have not checked yet. Let me check before confirming.

context: My application results came out.
How did it go?
message: I did not get selected and I feel quite upset.
diagnostic_anchor: I am sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about it?

context: I have been handling almost all the presentation slides.
Have the others taken any sections?
message: Not really. I am exhausted trying to do everything.
diagnostic_anchor: That sounds exhausting. Could we ask the others to share the work?

context: I finally finished my driving test.
How did it go?
message: I passed on my first try!
diagnostic_anchor: Congratulations! I am happy for you.

context: I am leaving for the library soon.
I am heading out too.
message: Remember to bring your water bottle.
diagnostic_anchor: Thanks for reminding me. I will bring it.

context: I sent you the event poster.
I noticed the venue was wrong.
message: I fixed the venue and sent you the updated version.
diagnostic_anchor: Thanks for fixing it and sending the updated version. I will check it.

context: I am still in class.
I am queuing at the drinks stall.
message: What would you like me to get you?
diagnostic_anchor: A cup of tea, please. Thank you for getting it for me.

context: We could meet near the station.
There are two exits.
message: Meet me there after your lesson.
diagnostic_anchor: Which exit should I meet you at after my lesson?

context: We are meeting for supper tonight.
Let me know if you can come.
message: Sorry, I have too much work and cannot join tonight.
diagnostic_anchor: No worries, we can meet another time.

context: We planned to study at the cafe.
It is getting noisy here.
message: Would you like to move to the reading room instead?
diagnostic_anchor: Yes, I would prefer somewhere quieter. Let us try the reading room.
